notes: Adds a native SwiftUI application for external Homebrew mpv, Python and VapourSynth on Apple Silicon/macOS 26+. The sole attached ZIP contains Open SVPflow.app, its two plugins, launcher, icons and required notices; external runtimes remain external. Local readiness checks gate playback, while dependency installation opens Terminal only after an explicit button click. Adds shared versioned settings, lossless legacy migration, ordered multi-file playback, append/replace/ask handling and an independent local Unix-IPC session. Quit App is the default after playback begins; menu-bar and keep-window modes are available. Settings apply to the next file, and reopening attaches to the owned session. The fixed film preset is not the SVP Automatic hardware profiler; unsupported official duplicate-cadence handling is disabled and mapping limitations are shown. The Rust engine, vector format and GPU kernels are unchanged from the previous prerelease. Source dimensions, aspect and ordinary mpv user configuration are preserved. No added internet client, telemetry or updater; explicit installers and external mpv retain network capabilities. Ad-hoc signed, not notarized, without App Sandbox; Gatekeeper approval may be required. Publication is gated by Rust/Python/Swift tests, extracted-package native playback, process-lifetime checks, signature and bundle verification. Explicit dependency repair refreshes stale Homebrew metadata before a required mpv upgrade; compatible mpv installations are not upgraded by that check.
